name: Academy Elementor Addons
author: Academy LMS

sections.description:
Academy Elementor Addons integrates Academy LMS with the Elementor page builder. Build your own course layouts and style every part of your eLearning site without writing code.

The plugin ships 10 widgets you can use on any page, 21 widgets for the single course template and a template builder for single course and course archive pages. Every widget comes with detailed style controls, so you can build an eLearning site that matches your brand.

Features

  • Template builder for single course and course archive pages.
  • 10 widgets for any page: user dashboard, registration form, course grid, course carousel, course filter, course search, login form, enroll form, curriculum topbar and curriculum sidebar.
  • 21 widgets for the single course template.
  • 2 widgets for the course archive template: course grid and course filter.
  • Live preview of every change in the Elementor editor.

Requirements

Academy Elementor Addons needs these free plugins installed and active:

  1. Academy LMS
  2. Elementor

Keep both plugins up to date for the best compatibility.

Customize the Course Page

Go to Academy EA > Template Builder in your dashboard. It comes with ready-made single course templates: activate one and your course pages get the new design right away.

Click Add New to create your own template, or open one of the default templates in Elementor and redesign it.

Widgets for Any Page

Find the widgets under Academy Widgets in the Elementor panel.

  1. User Dashboard
  2. Student/Instructor Registration
  3. Course Grid
  4. Course Carousel
  5. Course Filter
  6. Course Search
  7. Login Form
  8. Enroll Form
  9. Curriculum Topbar
  10. Curriculum Sidebar

Widgets for the Single Course Template

  1. Course Title
  2. Course Thumbnail
  3. Course Categories
  4. Course Tags
  5. Course Description
  6. Course Benefits
  7. Course Target Audience
  8. Course Requirements
  9. Course Materials
  10. Course Price
  11. Course Total Enrolled
  12. Course Level
  13. Course Rating
  14. Course Last Update
  15. Course Social Share
  16. Course Instructors
  17. Course Duration
  18. Course Curriculum
  19. Course Feedback
  20. Course Enroll
  21. Course Reviews

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Academy LMS and Elementor.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Academy Elementor Addons”, then install and activate it.
  3. Go to Academy EA > Template Builder to set up your course templates, or open any page in Elementor and use the Academy Widgets.
sections.faq:
Is Academy Elementor Addons free?

Yes, it is completely free. It needs Academy LMS and Elementor to work; the widgets are not available without them.

Does it work with my theme?

It is tested with recent default WordPress themes and Hello Elementor. If you find a conflict with your theme, please report it in the support forum.

Do I need the Pro version of Academy LMS or Elementor?

No. The free versions of Academy LMS and Elementor are enough.

Can I restyle my existing Academy LMS courses?

Yes. Templates apply to your existing courses, so you can give them a new look without editing each course.
